Write a detailed paragraph about the history of the printing press, covering Gutenberg, movable type, the spread of print shops across Europe, and the effect on literacy.

The printing press, developed by Johannes Gutenberg around 1440, combined movable metal type with an adapted screw press, and within fifty years print shops had spread to hundreds of European cities, making books cheaper and literacy far more common.
